rules.title: House rules
rules.subtitle: Lumièrebourg University City · Last updated: January 2025
rules.intro: These house rules apply to all residents, visitors, and staff of Lumièrebourg University City. They define everyone's rights and obligations to ensure a calm, respectful environment conducive to study.
rules.seoDescription: Read the house rules of Lumièrebourg University City.

1.title: Article 1 — Room assignment.
1.body: Room assignment is strictly personal. The room may not be transferred, sublet, or occupied by a third party without express authorization from the administration.

2.title: Article 2 — Length of stay.
2.body: The housing contract is concluded for the current academic year. Any renewal is subject to administration approval and verification of the resident's student status.

3.title: Article 3 — Move-in.
3.body: Upon arrival, the resident completes a joint inventory with a city representative. Any damage noted at move-in is recorded in this document.

4.title: Article 4 — Respect for neighbors.
4.body: Residents must respect their neighbors' peace and quiet. Quiet hours are required between 10 p.m. and 8 a.m. Repeated disturbances may lead to disciplinary action.

5.title: Article 5 — Common areas.
5.body: Shared spaces (kitchens, study rooms, laundry rooms, halls) must be left clean after use. Perishable food not stored properly or bulky items are prohibited.

6.title: Article 6 — Visitors.
6.body: Visitors are allowed between 8 a.m. and 10 p.m. They may not stay in rooms for more than 72 consecutive hours. The resident is responsible for their guests' behavior.

7.title: Article 7 — Equipment.
7.body: Residents must use provided equipment carefully and immediately report any breakdown or damage via the maintenance request portal.

8.title: Article 8 — Fire safety.
8.body: It is strictly forbidden to disable or obstruct fire safety devices. Candles, gas burners, or any open-flame devices in rooms are prohibited.

9.title: Article 9 — Access.
9.body: The access card is personal and non-transferable. In case of loss, the resident must immediately inform the administration and pay for a replacement.

sanctions.title: Disciplinary sanctions
sanctions.intro: Any breach of these rules may result in one of the following sanctions, decided by the disciplinary committee according to the severity of the facts:
items: Formal notice with obligation to remedy
Early termination of the housing contract
sanctions.outro: The resident is informed of any procedure initiated against them and has fifteen days to submit observations.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: Lumièrebourg University City · Last updated: January 2025
privacy.intro: Lumièrebourg University City is committed to protecting the privacy of its residents and users. This policy describes the personal data collected, the purposes of processing, and your rights under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR — EU 2016/679).
privacy.seoDescription: Privacy policy and personal data processing at Lumièrebourg University City.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p1: The data controller for personal data collected via the Campus Flow platform is Lumièrebourg University City, headquartered in Paris, France.
controller.p2: For any question about data protection, you may contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) at

collected.title: Data collected
collected.intro: In the context of managing your housing, we collect:
items: Identification data: name, date of birth, student number
Contact details: email address, phone number
Academic data: faculty, study level, institution
Supporting documents: student card, proof of address
Connection data: IP address, session timestamps

purposes.title: Processing purposes
purposes.intro: Your data is used exclusively for the following purposes:
items: Processing housing applications and managing contracts
Communication related to your stay (notifications, announcements)
purposes.outro: No data is transferred to third parties for commercial purposes.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.p1: Personal data is retained only as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, in accordance with applicable legal obligations.
retention.p2: After the housing contract ends, your data is archived for five years to meet legal obligations, then permanently deleted.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

access.title: Right of access
access.body: obtain a copy of your data

portability.title: Right to portability
portability.body: receive your data in a structured format

rights.outro: To exercise your rights, send your request to
rights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
